evidence.quote: decided to leave our policy interest rate unchanged
we don’t see a strong case for moving in either direction
we do see good reasons to think that some or all of the unexpected decrease may wind up being transient
Economic growth and job creation have both been a bit stronger than we anticipated, while inflation has been somewhat weaker.
While concerns remain in all of these areas, it appears that risks have moderated somewhat.
In March, we decided to slow the pace of balance sheet runoff, starting this month, and to cease runoff entirely in September.
